I think Nintendo will continue making hardware as long as they can, and I don't see Microsoft dropping Xbox anytime soon even if the waters get rough. I need consoles to continue existing purely for physical media. I've got a low bandwidth cap so I still buy games on disc, which is much harder on PC. My worry is that the more consoles drop features like local multiplayer and physical media, the less compelling a choice they become.
